body.x: Pets cannot say when something feels wrong, and by the time they show it the problem may be well along. A clearer view of what is happening inside would help vets act sooner.
Metaimmunetech was named a 2027 Honoree in Pet & Animal Tech at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for Cellytics Pet Immunity: AI-native health checkup platform for companion animals.

Cellytics Pet Immunity (CPI) is billed as the world's first AI-native comprehensive health assessment platform for companion animals, integrating functional immune intelligence with electronic medical records (EMRs). Using only a small blood sample, CPI employs patented lens-less digital hologram technology to analyze real-time polymorphonuclear neutrophil (PMN) and cytotoxic lymphocyte (CTL) immune responses at the single-cell level.
AI then combines these live biological signals with each patient's clinical history, CBC, blood chemistry and other EMR data to generate a unified, evidence-based health assessment.

By revealing hidden immune dysfunction like cancer before clinical symptoms become apparent, CPI is meant to enable earlier intervention, personalized treatment and proactive disease management, shifting veterinary medicine from reactive care to predictive precision healthcare.

The CES Innovation Awards program, an annual competition honoring outstanding design and engineering in consumer technology products, recognizes all recipients as Honorees at two levels. The Honoree level covers products that score above the scoring threshold in each category, while Best of Innovation goes to the highest-scoring Honorees. A panel of industry expert judges and global media scores each product on engineering and functionality, aesthetic and design, and what makes it unique and innovative.

AVING NEWS, a global media company with 21 years of experience covering CES, operates AVING CES Newsroom (avingces.news), a dedicated platform for delivering the latest innovations to global audiences. Publishing more than 1,000 articles and conducting hundreds of on-site video interviews annually, AVING NEWS has helped Korean startups gain international visibility and expand their global reach. At CES 2027, AVING NEWS will operate the AVING TECH TALK broadcast zone at the Venetian Expo (Hall A, Booth 50271), providing on-site coverage and interviews that spotlight Korean companies and their latest innovations.
